title: Send-Date Ledger
user: Freelancers who draft an invoice while work evolves and need the issued date, due date, and sent version to remain unambiguous.

evidence.quote_or_summary: An invoicing-platform builder identifies freelancer frustration with forced payment methods and over-complicated small-business interfaces.
A user says invoices can be created weeks before send while work is added, and asks that the invoice date reflect sending rather than draft creation.

recurrence: A 2025 request for less-bloated freelancer invoicing and a concrete 2026 date-error request point to an avoidable record-keeping failure.
current_workaround: Edit dates by hand in an invoice app or duplicate a draft just before emailing it.
incumbents_and_gap: FreshBooks, Wave, and Invoice Ninja manage complete invoices, but draft-versus-issued chronology is rarely a small, visible, exportable control.
smallest_useful_product: Offline invoice issue register: import or enter a PDF/amount, record draft, issued, sent, due, and paid events, and export a monthly ledger. Non-goals: accounting ledger, tax calculation, or payment gateway.
success_measure: For a pilot month, 95% of issued invoices have a recorded sent date and a due date generated from a visible rule.
monetization: one-time — local audit hygiene is a focused utility rather than a financial SaaS suite.
constraints: Dates must be timezone-aware and immutable once exported; do not present the register as statutory bookkeeping; browser storage needs encrypted export option.
why_distinct: It is a chronology guardrail around existing invoices, not another invoice creator.
